text:
The initial number of computers in the server room was 9.

The installations occurred on each day from Monday to Thursday inclusive. These are exactly 4 days (Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday).

Exactly 5 computers were installed on each of those days, for a total of \(5 \times 4 = 20\) computers installed.

Adding the newly installed computers to the original number produces a current total of \(9 + 20 = 29\).

Final answer: \(29\)
